sloka: अभिवाद्य तु संसिद्ध: कृत्वा चैनं प्रदक्षिणम् ।आमन्त्र्य भरत: सेन्यं युज्यतामित्यचोदयत् ॥ २.९२.३१॥
transliteration: abhivādya tu saṁsiddha: kṛtvā cainaṁ pradakṣiṇam ।āmantrya bharata: senyaṁ yujyatāmityacodayat ॥ 2.92.31॥

translations.english: Having paid obeisance, the accomplished Bharata circumambulated sage Bharadwaja, look leave of him, and ordered his army to get ready.
